verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud AI generation API like Luma, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, data residency selection, or regional endpoints. The 'Dedicated capacity' enterprise tier concerns throughput and latency, not data location, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
